default.notes: A visa from a North Macedonian embassy is required — though holders of a valid multiple-entry Schengen (type C) visa can enter without one for up to 15 days per visit.

groups.notes: Visa-free for up to 90 days in any 180-day period. EU citizens can also enter with a biometric national ID card for visits of up to 15 days.

RU.notes: Visa-free entry for Russian citizens has been maintained under periodically renewed government decisions — confirm the current terms before travel.
